messages:
maya: heads up — gating sweep for the open-models catalog. We need final signoff on license + perf for 'fenrir-6b-quant' before we flip traffic. ETA EOD? :hourglass:

sam: I can run the perf profile this morning. Quick Q: are we using GPTQ-4bit or the 8-bit baseline? I saw two configs in the intake manifest.

maya: planned is GPTQ-4bit for latency, but legal flagged the model card missing attribution. @nina-legal can you confirm whether the license text is sufficient or we need vendor approval?

nina-legal: nina-legal: quick note — the license looks MIT-ish but there's a fork with a "no-commercial" clause. Need confirmation from model steward. If no reply by 5pm we can't ship.

alex-infra: infra note — the GPTQ weights increase VRAM on warmup by ~30% on p4d. We can reduce token packing to lower mem but that increases per-token cost. Running a mem profile now.

sam: perf run finished: p95 latency ~220ms with GPTQ-4bit at batch=1, seq=512. Throughput is within SLA. Uploading artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/1725550000 (logs + perf graphs).

maya: can we do a 5% canary for 2h and monitor quality metrics? need a rollback plan if hallucination rate or coherence drops.

kaitlyn-product: product ask — prefer a 4h canary if infra/cost allows. We've seen delayed coherence regressions after ~3h in previous models.

devops-bot: deploybot: canary deployment queued for fenrir-6b-quant -> production at 5% traffic. id: deploy_8812. Trigger when infra gives green.

alex-infra: mem profile uploaded to the artifact bucket. If we keep current packing we hit ~85% mem and risk OOM on p4d under burst. Recommend provisioning 1 reserved node for the canary window.

sam: I can shadow-run inference on a copied workload for the next hour to catch perf drift. Also will run the eval promptset for coherence and calibration.

nina-legal: update: steward responded — the "no-commercial" clause applies only to redistribution of weights, not service inference. Legal gives conditional OK; will attach signed note.

maya: great. owners for canary: @sam (perf/eval), @alex-infra (infra/provisioning), @kaitlyn-product (UX/metrics), @nina-legal (license watch). Post-canary checklist: perf regression, error spikes, token-cost delta, quality regression on eval set. I'll post results in ~2.5h. :white_check_mark:

luis-sre: adding monitors/alerts now: if p99 latency > 400ms or error rate > 0.5% we'll auto-rollback. Also tracking cost delta > 20% vs baseline.

maya: thanks — locking this thread for updates only. Please @mention me on blockers.

sam: noted, starting continuous eval now.

alex-infra: provisioning reserved node now, ETA 18m.

kaitlyn-product: will watch user-facing logs and chat UX channels during canary.

maya: closing loop — will post canary results and final gate decision when ready.
